admission.justification: The two member obligations hold only together: plain-text note composition and canonical-file controller reads jointly guarantee that instruction text carries launch choices without ever changing authority or grants. Retired per L71-MEM-07: the authority-preservation promise is already made by INV-1Q4W04 alone and controller file reading is an independent member fact; member facts retained, no joint guarantee claimed.

guarantee: Launch instruction text is composed as plain-text append or overwrite from admitted sources only; composition changes no tool grant and no settings authority, controllers read canonical rendered files through harness file tools, and taskless roles honestly report having no own task file.
title: instruction-text-composition-without-authority-change
